title: THE LIVING INTERVAL
line: Gurdjieff's Ray of Creation, as recorded by P. D. Ouspensky.

title: ONE SELECTED RAY
line: Seven successive world orders—not a beam of physical light.

title: THE LAW OF THREE
line: Active, passive and neutralizing forces meet: three roles in every phenomenon.

title: ORDERS OF LAWS
line: The numbers count governing orders of forces, not named laboratory rules.

title: A DEEPENING ORDER
line: Lower worlds bear more laws; the teaching calls their life more mechanical.

title: THE PLANETARY WORLD
line: A selected world of planets belongs to the larger order.

title: THE LAW OF SEVEN
line: The cosmic octave has an interval between the planets and Earth.

title: THE LIVING INTERMEDIARY
line: Organic life fills that interval and receives planetary influences.

title: THE SENSITIVE FILM
line: Plants, animals and people form Earth’s living organ of perception.

title: DIFFERENT LIVING RECEIVERS
line: Grassland and a human gathering receive different influences, in this account.

title: RECEPTION AND MEDIATION
line: Influence reaches life; a distinct living response moves inward to Earth.

title: WHAT IS BEING TRANSMITTED?
line: The source calls these planetary influences; their physical nature is unspecified.

title: RADIATION OUTWARD
line: Life also radiates differently toward Sun, planets and Moon.

title: ONE CONNECTED COSMOLOGY
line: Hierarchy, interval, living mediation and reciprocal radiations belong together.
